chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: John Kirby and the tuba fading out
summary: Jackson first saw Kirby with Fletcher in 1930 playing both tuba and bass, and he was the first tuba player with lip vibrato.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: How about Kirby? Did you ever know little Kirby,

Yes, I knew John Kirby. John Kirby, why, I first saw him with Fletcher's band in 1930 down in Cincinnati, he had his tuba and his bass fiddle. Now, he was the first tuba player I heard play a lip vibrato on the tuba, and it was pretty. It was pretty, although he didn't play tuba too much after Fletcher's band. I don't know -- when he went with Lucky Millinder, he left Fletcher and went with Lucky, I don't know whether he played too much tuba then.
Well, the tuba was beginning to fade out.
It was beginning to get into the bass fiddle era.
